package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"time"
)

// Lesson status constants.
const (
	LessonStatusNoActive = 0
	LessonStatusActive   = 1
)

// Lesson represents reusable lesson content.
type Lesson struct {
	ID        string
	SourceKey string
	// SectionID, ModuleID, CourseID, and Order are placement context fields populated by list queries.
	SectionID        string
	ModuleID         string
	CourseID         string
	Title            string
	Excerpt          string
	Description      string
	ComposeConfigID  *string
	ComposeConfig    json.RawMessage
	Versions         []LessonVersion
	Order            int
	Status           int
	LessonReadAccess *LessonReadAccess `json:"lesson_read_access,omitempty"`
	CreatedAt        time.Time
	UpdatedAt        time.Time
}

// SectionLesson represents a lesson placement inside a section.
type SectionLesson struct {
	ID        string
	SectionID string
	LessonID  string
	Order     int
	Status    int
	CreatedAt time.Time
	UpdatedAt time.Time
}

// LessonI18n stores localized lesson title/description.
type LessonI18n struct {
	LessonID    string
	I18nID      int
	Language    string
	Title       string
	Excerpt     string
	Description string
}

// LessonTeacherContext is a bounded, current Course-owned content snapshot for
// a teacher response. Revision identifies the exact current lesson update; it
// is not an immutable historical version.
type LessonTeacherContext struct {
	LessonID    string
	CourseID    string
	SectionID   string
	Language    string
	Title       string
	Excerpt     string
	Description string
	Revision    time.Time
}
